newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Mitac soars on Merisel purchase.
newsitem.headline: Mitac soars on Merisel purchase.

text.p: Taiwan's Mitac International soared at mid-session on Tuesday following news that its U.S. unit has decided to acquire majority shares of a subsidiary of U.S. computer distributor Merisel Inc, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, Mitac had gained T$2 or 5.88 percent to T$36. Trade volume was a hectic 36.99 million shares.

Mitac, through its U.S. unit Synnex Information Technologies Inc, would acquire Computerland Franchise and Datago Aggregation Business run by Merisel Inc's subsidiary Merisel FAB, Mitac said in a statement on Tuesday.
Mitac said annual sales revenue of its U.S. unit would soar past US$2 billion in 1997 from US$1 billion in 1996, partly as a result of the merger.
"The deal strengthened investor confidence in Mitac and made the company an easy target for buying in an already bullish market," said Allen Huang, a manager at National Securities.
The overall index, which hit a six-year high on Monday, was up another 57.14 points to 7,311.46 with 55 minutes left in Tuesday's session.
